This is such an important debate. A lot depends on whether a) there really is an existential danger to humanity from AGI and b) whether AGI is getting near. But precisely because of AI's amazingness - and also because, as we've discovered this past week, it's nigh impossible to stand in the way of AI's take-off - this is a danger that could come upon us with unprecedented speed and peril. There's a real risk that at some point in the next 10 years, we wake up and discover that humans have completely lost control of the world.
I'm a huge fan of yours, Steve, but it's possible you're wrong on this one. It's possible that EA is absolutely right to be focused on this.
